==Description==
'''A-20''' is the first entity a new player will meet. It has a blue smiley face, has a trail and sounds like a train. It is very slow and can be avoided easily.

==Behavior==
When A-20 spawns, it will make a breathing sound. A-20 will rush to the current room at a slow pace and will slow down once it’s 2 rooms away. Once A-20 touches the door to the next room, A-20 will break in half and despawn. Instead of instantly killing the player, A-20 does rapid damage to them. The further the player goes, the rarer it becomes.

==Trivia==
*The movement sound of '''A-20''' is the edited sound of a mechanical keyboard.
*'''A-20''' does not care about tables, and will act as if the player isn't hiding at all
*'''A-20's''' name was previously going to get changed to A-25, this has now been reverted.
*'''A-20''' will be rarer past A-1000 and will stop spawning past A-2000
*As of the Executive Update, '''A-20''' can now spawn in the [[Red Rooms]]
*The modifier <nowiki>''Stay Alert''</nowiki> adds a timer to '''A-20''' which can cause multiple A-20's being active at the same time

== Bugs ==
· A-20 cannot spawn if any modifier that isn't <nowiki>''</nowiki>Stay Alert<nowiki>''</nowiki> is active. Instead, [[A-20i]] will always replace it
